summary: Frontier Nuclear & Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K to provide notice of its upcoming Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for August 25, 2026. The filing sets the record date for notice and voting as July 16, 2026, and specifies that common shares are entitled to receive notice and vote. The notice is given pursuant to Section 128(4) of The Corporations Act (Manitoba). No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate governance notice for an annual meeting and does not qualify as a special situation.
